newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's ABC to produce RC brands.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's ABC to produce RC brands.

text.p: Recently privatised al-Ahram Beverages/ABC said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent with Royal Crown (RC) Cola International to be exclusive producer of Royal Crown brands in Egypt.

ABC has been a Pepsi Cola bottler, producing both Pepsi and Shani orange-flavoured drink. but its contract with Pepsi expires on July 2, a company statement said. It expects to launch RC Cola brands in Egypt in September.
ABC executives said it would start by making a cola drink, an orange drink and a third drink of unspecified flavour.
ABC also has a licensing agreement for beer with Danish brewer Carlsberg.
Royal Crown is a unit of Triarc.
